The theorem makes no assertion outside that domain.

value.rationale: For a newly sharp inequality, identifying the entire equality manifold is structurally important and is a prerequisite for a well-posed stability theory. The focal paper constructs an extremizer but does not exhaust equality cases. The new argument rules out nonradial regular equality profiles and gives a complete natural classification in the source-matched square domain for every genuinely higher order \(m\ge3\). This is not a routine substitution, an arbitrary slice, or a finite computation; its scope limitation is explicit.
